reasons: Both answers give the same correct ROW_NUMBER query and meet every rubric item. A correctly notes that ties on both amount and created_at leave the order undefined and recommends adding id as a tiebreaker. B wrongly says the order is total and that ROW_NUMBER stays deterministic on such ties, and it overstates the index benefit.

B: Claims ROW_NUMBER gives a deterministic result when both amount and created_at are equal; in PostgreSQL the order of such peers is unspecified.
Claims the index can cut query time from seconds to milliseconds, which is overstated for a query that still reads every row.
